_comment: Helsinki (Helsingin päärautatieasema, Digitraffic HKI). Draft from OSM via Overpass (cached 2026-10-28), schema 2. Platforms 1-19 are tagged in OSM at ground level (no level tag); the station hall and Asematunneli are tagged indoor with levels 2, 1, 0 and -1 (OSM uses 0 for the street level here). Platforms H0018-H0021 at level -3 are the Pisararata reservation/ metro and are left out of the walking levels. Names from VR's/Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency's plans still to be checked; the owner's video covers the hall and platforms.

sources.note: Helsingin laserkeilausaineisto 2021, © Helsingin kaupunki, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_HKI).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, cached 2026-10-28), schema 2.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 30 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_HKI).
